description: Michael Devin at the Pacific Marine Energy Center publishes FOWT Force Gen, a Python workflow for floating offshore wind-turbine loads. Zenodo archives the June 2020 pre-release, free under MIT. Given site coordinates and a platform choice, it obtains NOAA buoy wind and wave information, prepares OpenFAST and TurbSim inputs and exports simulated forces and motions as MATLAB files. It also prepares MoorDyn settings and parses existing OpenFAST output. This supports site-specific load and reliability studies alongside the previously drafted model-openfast. Coverage depends on available buoy records and user-selected scenarios. The documented platform is OC4-DeepCwind; OC3-Hywind is described as future work. Limitations include pre-release bugs, execution from the package root and reliance on separately installed OpenFAST and TurbSim. No simulation was run, and present compatibility with upstream versions was not checked. Its reusable input-generation and parsing functions justify reopening the earlier rejection based on age and narrow application.
